name: Stellenbosch
blurb: Conversation about Stellenbosch is up 154% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find
Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: The food alone would be worth the trip.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
